title: Oscar and the Static
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Ines Coldharbour, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
